main.description: A PUBLIC post, written to the creator's own PDS and visible on the open AT network. Subscriber-only / paid post bodies are NEVER stored as this record type — see the Post model and visibility rules in prompts/full.md PHASE 7. This lexicon is for the public-post half of that split only.

text.description: May be an empty string if there are embeds.

labels.description: Self-label content warnings for this post, using the core protocol's self-label mechanism.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this post was originally created.
